forum.title: Are TSV321RAILT & TSV321RILT pin configurations exactly the same?
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @n\_minakata, to the community!

The two order designations differ exclusively in the offset voltage, which is indicated by the inserted letter 'A'. The offset values are given in the [data sheet](https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/tsv321.pdf), table 3 for VCC=3V and table 4 for VCC=5V.

The pin assignment is exactly identical for both.

Does it answer your question?

Regards

/Peter
